heard_on_the_hill.headline: Warren issues statement on Nvidia CEO spy plot reports
heard_on_the_hill.body: Senator Warren issued a statement through the Senate Banking Committee on October 29 on reports that NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang was seen as the target of a Chinese spy plot. The Wall Street Journal and New York Times reported that U.S. intelligence concluded a Chinese executive tied to Singapore-based data-center firm Megaspeed developed a close relationship with Huang and may have relayed insight on U.S. AI policy to Beijing.

research.title: Transshipment Crackdowns Won’t Fix the U.S.-China Trade Imbalance
research.line: Challenges the White House claim that Chinese exports are rerouted through third countries to circumvent U.S. tariffs, highlighting persistent structural issues.
